header_subtitle: Four league teams, one club: Men's Masters in Division 1 and three Ladies Masters teams across the Hong Kong Hockey League.
mens_text: For the first time in many years, HK Masters Hockey will field a men's team in the Hong Kong Hockey League, competing in the First Division. The season kicks off Friday 2 October, with fixtures every Friday night at 20:30 at the Hong Kong Football Club (HKFC).
sidebar_join_text: Interested in joining HK Masters Hockey? Register your interest to get involved.
registration_fee_description: Become a registered Masters player and receive regular updates, tournament announcements, and club news.
division_one_fee_description: Required once selected to play in the Hong Kong Hockey League First Division.
join_text: Come try out for HK's first men's Masters team in years.
ladies_heading: Three Ladies Teams in the League
ladies_text: Hong Kong Masters Hockey fields three Ladies Masters teams in the Hong Kong Hockey League. Masters A plays in the Premier League, Masters B in Division 2, and Masters C in Division 3.

squads.name: MO40
squads.description: The MO40 squad is a blend of experience and energy. With players drawn from Hong Kong's vibrant hockey community, this team is gearing up for a strong showing in Rotterdam.

squads.name: MO50
squads.description: The MO50 squad has a proud history on the international masters stage. Seasoned, tactical and never short of passion, this group is ready to fly the HK flag once again in Rotterdam.

league_header_subtitle: Four league teams, one club: Men's Masters in Division 1 and three Ladies Masters teams across the Hong Kong Hockey League.
league_ladies_heading: Three Ladies Teams in the League
league_intro: HK Masters Hockey is a home for experienced players. Our Ladies and Men's teams share the same club spirit, community and player fees.
ladies_league_text: Our Ladies Masters field three teams in the Hong Kong Hockey League this season. Squad lists will be shared here once confirmed.
league_squad_fee_description: Required once selected to play for a Men's or Ladies Masters team in the Hong Kong Hockey League.
league_fees_note: The same fees apply to Men's and Ladies Masters players.
league_join_text: Experienced player looking for a team? Ladies and men are both welcome. Register your interest and we will help you find the right squad.
